rules.name: assoc-array-bash4
rules.message: Associative arrays need bash 4+; this suite must run under the system /bin/bash 3.2 (AGENTS.md). Gate the script behind a version check that re-execs or skips, as memory-auto-clean.sh does.

rules.name: mapfile-bash4
rules.message: mapfile/readarray need bash 4+; the suite must run under /bin/bash 3.2 (AGENTS.md). Use a while-read loop instead.

rules.name: hard-edge-trap
rules.message: UI trap (v2.7.1): the hard edge paints an opaque backdrop that fights the Settings window. Do not use it in this app.

rules.name: list-section-spacing
rules.message: iOS-only modifier (AGENTS.md UI traps); it does not apply on macOS.

rules.name: swift-warning-marker
rules.message: Warnings are defects in this repo (AGENTS.md): fix the cause, never defer one with #warning.

rules.name: monorepo-js-ext
rules.message: Remove .js extension from imports. bundler moduleResolution resolves .ts directly.

rules.name: security-eval
rules.message: Never use eval(). It enables code injection attacks. Use JSON.parse(), Function constructor with validation, or structured alternatives.

rules.name: security-innerhtml
rules.message: dangerouslySetInnerHTML risks XSS. Sanitize with DOMPurify or use a markdown renderer. Never pass user input directly.

rules.name: security-hardcoded-secrets
rules.message: Possible hardcoded API key/secret detected. Use environment variables instead.

rules.name: public-env-secrets
rules.message: Secret value in a public/bundled env var (VITE_ / EXPO_PUBLIC_ / PUBLIC_ / NUXT_PUBLIC_). Those prefixes are inlined into the client bundle at build time — Vite 8: VITE_* must not contain API keys; Expo: do not store private keys in EXPO_PUBLIC_. Secrets stay on a server. Next.js NEXT_PUBLIC_ is the same class (nextjs-public-env-secrets).

rules.name: client-secret-handoff
rules.message: HTTP 200 JSON `{ key }` or setKey of a fetched body hands stored credential material to the browser. Next.js data-security: don't include secret tokens as public fields; OWASP: never transmit secrets in plaintext. Keep the secret on the server and proxy, or mint a short-lived token. Dev-only is still a handoff. Mark a genuine exception with secret-handoff-allow.

rules.name: client-secret-json-field
rules.message: JSON response includes a secret-shaped field (apiKey / accessToken / service_role / privateKey / llmKey). Next.js data-security: Server Action and Route Handler return values are sent to the client — only return what the UI needs. Proxy with the secret on the server. Mark a genuine exception with secret-handoff-allow.

rules.name: client-secret-web-storage
rules.message: Writing a fetched key/token/secret into localStorage or sessionStorage. The browser is not a secret store — keep credentials on the server and proxy, or use a short-lived httpOnly cookie issued by the origin. Mark a genuine exception with secret-handoff-allow.

rules.name: security-prototype-pollution
rules.message: Prototype pollution vector detected. __proto__ and constructor.prototype manipulation enables RCE (CVE-2025-55182 class). Use Object.create(null) or Map for user-controlled data.

rules.name: security-sql-injection
rules.message: SQL template literal with interpolation detected — SQL injection risk. Use parameterized queries (supabase.from().select(), pg prepared statements) instead.

rules.name: security-dom-innerhtml
rules.message: Direct innerHTML assignment enables XSS (2.74x more common in AI code — CodeRabbit 2025). Use textContent, React JSX, or DOMPurify.sanitize().

rules.name: security-url-credentials
rules.message: URL with embedded credentials detected. Use environment variables for auth, never hardcode user:pass in URLs.

rules.name: security-console-secrets
rules.message: Logging potentially sensitive data (password/token/secret). Remove before production or use structured logging with redaction.

rules.name: security-empty-catch
rules.message: Empty catch block silently swallows errors (1.88x more common in AI code). At minimum, log the error or re-throw.

rules.name: lint-suppression-blanket
rules.message: Blanket eslint-disable disables ALL rules for the entire file. Fix the lint errors instead. If one rule must be disabled, use /* eslint-disable specific-rule */.

rules.name: lint-suppression-blanket
rules.message: eslint-disable-next-line without a rule name disables ALL rules for the next line. Specify the rule: // eslint-disable-next-line rule-name

rules.name: lint-suppression-blanket
rules.message: @ts-nocheck disables TypeScript checking for the entire file. Fix the type errors instead.

rules.name: lint-suppression-blanket
rules.message: Blanket biome-ignore without a rule name. Specify: // biome-ignore lint/specific-rule: reason

rules.name: as-any
rules.message: 'as any' detected. Use a type guard, satisfies, or fix the type at its source.

rules.name: double-cast
rules.message: 'as unknown as T' detected. Use a type guard to narrow unknown to T.

rules.name: eslint-ts-disable
rules.message: eslint-disable directive detected. Fix the lint error or scope the disable to the narrowest line and rule — a file-level disable hides every future violation too.

rules.name: biome-ignore-detect
rules.message: biome-ignore directive detected. Fix the lint error, or scope the ignore to the exact rule and line (anti-patterns research §2.1 — Biome requires the reason inline; keep it next to the fix, not the file top).

rules.name: oxlint-disable-detect
rules.message: oxlint-disable directive detected. Name the specific rule and narrowest span, or fix the error (oxlint requires no reason — the bare form hides everything).

rules.name: non-null-assertion
rules.message: Non-null assertion (!) detected. Use optional chaining (?.) with a null guard.

rules.name: underscore-unused
rules.message: Underscore-prefixed unused variable detected. Remove it. For catch blocks, use catch {} (TS 5.x optional catch binding).

rules.name: any-param
rules.message: Parameter typed as 'any' detected. Define an interface. Use React.ChangeEvent<T>, useLocalSearchParams<T>, etc.

rules.name: return-assertion
rules.message: Return type assertion detected. Use satisfies, a type guard, or annotate the function return type.

rules.name: hidden-any-generic
rules.message: Hidden 'any' in generic type parameter (Record<string, any>, Array<any>, etc.). Use 'unknown' or a specific type.

rules.name: lazy-type
rules.message: Lazy type (Function or Object). Use specific signature (() => void) or Record<string, unknown>.

rules.name: any-return
rules.message: Function with explicit ': any' return type. Define the actual return type.

rules.name: eslint-ts-disable
rules.message: eslint-disable for @typescript-eslint rule detected. Fix the type.
